content: दिष्टिः {%f.%} [दिश भावे क्तिन्, संज्ञायां कर्तरि क्तिच् वा] .²1 Assignment, allotment. .²2 Direction, command, instruction, rule, precept. .²3 Fate, fortune, destiny. .²4 Good fortune, happiness, any auspicious event (such as the birth of a son); दिष्टिवृद्धिमिव शुश्राव <ls>K. 55</ls>; दिष्टिवृद्धिसंभ्रमो महानभूत् <ls>K. 70</ls>. .²5 A sort of measure of length.
